system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.11.2 - Light Mastery. Flares and dancing/fantastic lights, blurring and blinding a target, layered Optic Protection against visual attacks, lightning arcs/bolts and orbs of light, 'Fettered' attacks that also bind electrical energy into the target, mesmerizing/discordant color patterns, and Light Mastery itself letting the caster use any lower spell on this list every round. Special notes from the source: Fettered spells bind electrical energy into the target in addition to the raw attack; blind creatures are unaffected by this list's Force spells except the Fettered ones; every self-range spell centers on the caster, who is affected by it too but gets a special +25 to resist; Resistance Rolls against the color spells (Colours of Calming/Discord) improve with distance since the patterns grow less distinct further away; and Optic Protection spells stack with Light Protection spells against this list's visual attacks. Fidelity note: level 11's table name is printed as "Fettered Arc True", but its own description reads as the base spell (full mechanic spelled out, not "as Fettered Arc, except...") and level 20 (Fettered Bolt True) in turn cites level 11 as "Fettered Arc" with no "True" - kept exactly as printed in both places rather than guessing which one is the error. Type normalization note: the source prints "E(F)" for the three Fettered spells (bolt-table attack plus a Force-like RR/binding effect) and "varies" for Light Mastery itself, but this system's spell Type field only accepts E/BE/DE/F/P/U/I - the Fettered spells were mapped to DE (they resolve on a bolt attack table exactly like other DE spells; the binding/RR text is left as descriptive flavor for manual GM adjudication) and Light Mastery to U (it grants an action, not an attack or effect of its own).

A colored flare is shot from the caster's palm extending out 100'. Flare illuminates a 10' R surrounding itself. Flare falls at a rate of 10' per round. Color of light may be chosen by the caster at the time of casting.
Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.
Target's eyes are protected by a transparent field. This gives a +25 bonus to visual attacks (i.e., blinding, stoning, sudden light/dark, etc.)
Caster creates up to 1 globe per level of twinkling, dancing lights; those viewing the lights must resist at +20 or stare in fascination at dazzling patterns.
Creates a series of aerial light explosions (akin to fireworks) for up to 1 round per level of the caster.
An arc of lightning is shot from the caster's palm. Attack is resolved on the Lightning Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.
All within sight of caster are blinded for 1 rnd per 10% failure; caster is affected too but has a +25 to resist the effects of this spell.
An orb of coruscating light is shot at target. Target must resist or is blinded 1 round per 5% failure.

A bolt of concentrated light is shot from caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Shock Bolt Table. If target takes at least a single concussion hit of damage then target must resist (no BAR) this spell or take an 'A' Electricity critical 1 round per 10% failure. Resistance rolls are modified by the critical attained on the Shock Bolt Table: no critical +50; 'A' critical +30; 'B' critical +10; 'C' critical +0.
As Optic Protection I, except target gains a +50 against visual attacks.

An arc of lighting shot at from caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties. If target takes at least a single concussion hit of damage then target must resist (no BAR) this spell or take an 'A' Electricity critical for 1 round per 10% failure. Resistance rolls are modified by the critical attained on the Lightning Bolt Table: no critical +50; 'A' critical +30; 'B' critical +10; 'C' critical +0; 'D' critical -5; 'E' critical -10; 'F' critical -15; 'G' critical -20; 'H' critical -25; 'I' critical -30.
As Optic Protection I, except it affects 1 target per level of the caster.
[RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R burst of "white" light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round and operate at -25 per 5% failure.
As Photonic Orb I, except two orbs are created and are targeted separately.

Creates a blinding light from the caster with a radius of up to 20 feet. Light is blinding, making vision impossible unless protected (-90 to moving maneuvers). Optic protection spells use their bonus to counter the blinding effect.

Caster creates a shimmer pattern of light around himself. All within area must make a resistance roll or can take no offensive actions, but may act in defense. Caster is affected by this spell but has a special +25 to resist the effects. Additionally those outside the radius of the spell can be affected, but gain a +1 bonus to their resistance roll for every foot of distance they are from the spell's area of effect.

Caster discharges lightning to all within 10' radius of caster. Resolve attack as a +50 Lightning Bolt with a special modifier of -5 for every foot they are distanced from the caster (ignore the normal range bonuses).
As Optic Protection I, except it provides a +75 against visual attacks.

As Colors of Calming, except that caster creates a vibrating mass of colors that are discordant with one another. All viewing the spell must make an RR every round or suffer the following effects: 0-10 Act with a -20 to actions, 11-20 Can only parry or do defensive actions, 21-30 Stunned for that round, 31-40 Stunned with a -20 to actions, 41+ Stunned and unable to Parry.
As Fettered Arc, except attack is a bolt instead of an arc.
As Optic Protection II, except it affects 1 target per level of the caster.
Target is made immune to all visual attacks.
Caster can use one spell from this list per round for the duration.
